mentions.claim_text: He says France and England have more firepower than Russia but Russia is about to use something wicked, and that he saw the black horse riding out of Russia at a gallop like a streak rather than a trot.
mentions.quote: I saw the black horse riding out of Russia
mentions.falsify_match: Russia uses a weapon type it has not used before and scarcity spreads across Europe.
mentions.falsify_miss: No new Russian weapon and no European scarcity.

mentions.claim_text: He notes the horse he sees is black rather than the red horse he would expect for war, and says he saw labs again with rats and vials where the virus is made so that it already has an antidote or vaccine.
mentions.quote: The virus has an antidote
mentions.falsify_match: A pandemic pathogen is shown to have had a countermeasure prepared in advance.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such pathogen, or no evidence of a prepared antidote.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him attention should be less on Iran and Israel and more on Europe, which is about to be the hot spot, and that everyone's attention is about to shift.
mentions.quote: Europe's about to be the hot spot, not Iran
mentions.falsify_match: European events displace the Middle East as the dominant story.
mentions.falsify_miss: The Middle East remains the centre of attention.

mentions.claim_text: He names a prime minister over England, plus France, Canada and Australia, with Germany and Italy set further back and less bold in the vision, saying it was mainly about the four men.
mentions.quote: It was more about the four men
mentions.falsify_match: Those four states form the active bloc while Germany and Italy hold back.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such grouping. He also gives a different four-country list minutes earlier.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Ukrainian president was not one of the four men but the puppet, a marionette with a long nose and a liar, manipulated by the four who are the backing for the missiles that are coming.
mentions.quote: He's the marionette with the long nose, the liar
mentions.falsify_match: Evidence that Ukrainian escalation decisions are being driven by those four leaders.
mentions.falsify_miss: Ukraine acts independently.

mentions.claim_text: He notes a 4.5 earthquake in Italy that day, says he does not know whether that is normal for Italy and that 4.5 is small, and that there was a bigger one in Texas.
mentions.quote: 4.5 is pretty small. That's not that big a deal
mentions.falsify_match: An Italian earthquake at the scale he described.
mentions.falsify_miss: Only ordinary Italian seismicity.

mentions.claim_text: He says nobody is trying to be flaky, that he wants to be real and will say he missed it if it was not accurate, then asks whether the Italian earthquakes are what he saw.
mentions.quote: if it's not accurate, I want to be real with you. I missed it
mentions.falsify_match: He later scores this correctly against what actually happened.
mentions.falsify_miss: He claims the small quakes as the fulfilment of an 8.2.

mentions.claim_text: He restates a major earthquake in Venice, an 8.2 in Rome, and a major volcanic eruption outside the water, which he says was one of the first visions he had when he came on the platform.
mentions.quote: I saw a major earthquake in Venice. 8.2 in Rome
mentions.falsify_match: An 8.2 at Rome and a major quake at Venice.
mentions.falsify_miss: No Italian earthquake above magnitude 7. Italy has never recorded an 8.0.

mentions.claim_text: Told of major wildfires in France, he says he did not see that, but that he saw wildfires in Colorado that were man-made arson and things being set on fire in Canada.
mentions.quote: I saw wildfires in Colorado and they were man-made arson
mentions.falsify_match: Arson-caused wildfires in Colorado and Canada.
mentions.falsify_miss: No arson wildfires in those places.

mentions.claim_text: He restates a major escalation of war in Ukraine, a poking of the bear, and that Russia was about to use weapons never seen before and end the cat and mouse games.
mentions.quote: Russia was about to use weapons that we've never seen before
mentions.falsify_match: Russia deploys a weapon type not previously used.
mentions.falsify_miss: The war continues with conventional weapons only.

mentions.claim_text: He says Russia's allies came to its aid and that Russia is using unprecedented weapons because strikes were reaching too far inland toward Moscow, and points to facilities being blown up as what he was told over a year ago.
mentions.quote: they were striking too far inland by Moscow
mentions.falsify_match: Deep strikes into Russia trigger a qualitative escalation.
mentions.falsify_miss: Deep strikes continue without escalation.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw a draft coming to the United States involving boys and girls, men and women, once the escalation runs out of control, and Apollyon coming up out of a pit and spinning like a top over Russia and Europe.
mentions.quote: I saw a draft coming to the United States of America
mentions.falsify_match: American conscription is reintroduced including women.
mentions.falsify_miss: No draft is called.

mentions.claim_text: He points to the dates on his earlier recording, saying the Apollyon vision came before Russia struck Ukraine, and that he said then that a world war would be seen in the days ahead.
mentions.quote: It was before even Putin decided to strike Ukraine
mentions.falsify_match: A world war is declared.
mentions.falsify_miss: No world war. The pre-commitment date is verifiable from the recording, which is worth crediting separately from the content.

mentions.claim_text: He says the draft would produce literal hell on earth in America because parents would refuse to give up their children, and that it would not be like the 1970s because morals have decayed.
mentions.quote: You ain't taking my kids to war
mentions.falsify_match: Mass civil resistance to conscription in America.
mentions.falsify_miss: No draft, or a draft accepted without unrest.

mentions.claim_text: On a report that Iran's new leader is more open to pursuing a nuclear weapon and that US intelligence say he will not last, he says he saw them take him out and that he is the number one target.
mentions.quote: I saw them take him out
mentions.falsify_match: Iran's new leader is removed or killed.
mentions.falsify_miss: He remains in place. Note US intelligence had already said he would not be there long, so this restates the report in front of him.

mentions.claim_text: Placed in Iran, he sees an EMP being contemplated that is strategic and tactical rather than covering the whole area, describing a weapon he has never seen shaped like a dome with a centrepiece like an egg yolk.
mentions.quote: It's tactical. It's not over the whole place, but tactical
mentions.falsify_match: A tactical electromagnetic pulse weapon is used against Iran.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such weapon is used.

mentions.claim_text: He says some of the material went to Syria and some to Iran, that Syria holds some kind of weapons of mass destruction, and that it concerns Damascus.
mentions.quote: I see Syria has some kind of weapons of mass destruction
mentions.falsify_match: Weapons of mass destruction are found in Syria near Damascus.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such find.

mentions.claim_text: He says the visible threat is the caboose of the plan and a distraction, that what they are really after is maximum impact civilian casualties, and that he sees it with Saudi Arabia too.
mentions.quote: Maximum impact civilian casualties
mentions.falsify_match: An attack whose visible element is cover for a larger civilian-casualty attack.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such attack pattern.

mentions.claim_text: He says there is a plan scheduled with Cuba and Iran involving drones that is being downplayed, and that they do not yet have the capability for a swarm and have to get it.
mentions.quote: There is a plan scheduled with Cuba and Iran
mentions.falsify_match: A coordinated Cuba and Iran drone operation against American targets.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such operation. He states himself that the capability does not yet exist.

mentions.claim_text: He calls it a red dawn experience and a D-Day for the nation, ties it to what is in the Cuban mountain encased in lead, and repeats the reasoning that if they cannot have it nobody will.
mentions.quote: If we can't have it, no one will
mentions.falsify_match: A coordinated multi-front attack on American soil.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such attack.

mentions.claim_text: He hears the instruction to activate the cells in Detroit and in the mosque, says he does not know whether there is a mosque in Detroit, offers that he may be off, then says the Lord told him it is not off.
mentions.quote: Activate the cells in Detroit in the mosque
mentions.falsify_match: A coordinated attack traced to a Detroit network.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such attack. Detroit's Dearborn area has the largest Arab American population in the country, which he appears not to know.

mentions.claim_text: He prays a hedge of protection around every battleship and military base, naming the Abraham Lincoln and a carrier he thinks is the George Bush, and asks that every plot be brought to nothing and the leaks exposed.
mentions.quote: There's a hedge of protection around every single battleship
mentions.falsify_match: No successful attack on an American carrier or base.
mentions.falsify_miss: A carrier or base is struck.

mentions.claim_text: He describes work to make men super strong by adding material from gorillas and other strong animals to build super soldiers, called a race between China and other countries he says he was told not to name.
mentions.quote: trying to make men super strong like Arnold Schwarzenegger
mentions.falsify_match: Genetic enhancement of soldiers using animal genes is confirmed in a state programme.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such programme surfaces.

mentions.claim_text: He cites a figure of one thousand seven hundred and thirty mosques open in England, then plays a clip of an Italian speaker as confirmation of his word about the five families rising in New York.
mentions.quote: 1,730 mosque in England have been open
mentions.falsify_match: Continued growth of Islamic institutions in England.
mentions.falsify_miss: The count is wrong or the trend reverses.

mentions.claim_text: He says he told the audience to watch what happens with the five families, jokes that the Italian speaker may be watching his videos, and treats her remark as confirmation.
mentions.quote: I said watch what happens with the five families
mentions.falsify_match: Organised crime families become a visible factor in New York politics.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such involvement. The five families is a stock phrase, so a stranger using it is not evidence.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw major solar explosions on the sun affecting the crust with major earthquakes on the Mississippi, with Missouri named and a little girl riding a bike on a gravel road.
mentions.quote: I saw solar explosions on the sun, major solar explosions
mentions.falsify_match: A major New Madrid earthquake coinciding with high solar activity.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such earthquake. There is no established mechanism linking solar flares to seismicity.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a 1930s dust bowl, repeats that the Lord gave a window and asks what will be done with it, and sees a storm in New York with fires everywhere and Philadelphia like a rat hole.
mentions.quote: I see a storm in New York. I see fires everywhere
mentions.falsify_match: Drought and dust bowl conditions across the American plains with urban unrest.
mentions.falsify_miss: Normal rainfall and no urban breakdown.

mentions.claim_text: He says he keeps seeing a storm running from Maine down to the Florida Keys that looks like a tsunami, and that by then it has already engulfed Europe.
mentions.quote: there's a storm from Maine all the way down to Florida Keys
mentions.falsify_match: A single storm system affecting the whole American east coast.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such storm.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is not crying that the sky is falling but that people should get their house in order, that what he sees is Jeremiah 24, and that the Lord is giving a window and asking what will be done with it.
mentions.quote: What I see is coming is Jeremiah 24
mentions.falsify_match: A national reversal for America matching the good and bad figs division.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such reversal.

mentions.claim_text: He says America will be shaken and will awaken, names the I-35 corridor and places in Oklahoma as remnant places, says Texas will be separate and Oklahoma will look different, and that Oklahoma has an opportunity to flip conservative.
mentions.quote: Texas will be separate
mentions.falsify_match: Texas moves toward separation and Oklahoma's political map changes.
mentions.falsify_miss: No change in either state's status.

mentions.claim_text: He says the answer is not political but the people, who must preach repentance and holiness and change a culture that has gone far left, naming social media as part of it.
mentions.quote: they've got to change the culture of America has gone far left
mentions.falsify_match: A visible turn toward those themes in American church life.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such turn.

mentions.claim_text: He says what shakes people awakens them, and that God will bring a great revival to America, Australia, Europe, England and South America with people saved by the millions.
mentions.quote: I've seen people by the millions come to the saving knowledge of Jesus
mentions.falsify_match: Mass conversions across those regions.
mentions.falsify_miss: No measurable change in religious affiliation.

mentions.claim_text: He prays against big oil spills in the Gulf intended to destroy the environment and against any major disruption from Cuba with drones.
mentions.quote: the big spills in the Gulf to destroy our planet
mentions.falsify_match: A major Gulf oil spill or a Cuban drone incident occurs.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He wonders aloud whether the devil has spit, says it does not matter to him, and states that when the Lord shows things they are symbolic of something.
mentions.quote: whenever you see things it's symbolic for something
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; a statement of how he reads his own material.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss, but it is the clause that lets any image be reinterpreted after the fact.

mentions.claim_text: Seeing papers signed as a covenant with many, he sees a storm in Berlin, sees Iraq, and sees a green cloak with white Arabic writing go across Europe and cover it.
mentions.quote: I saw a green cloak go over Europe
mentions.falsify_match: Islamic political dominance across Europe.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such shift.

mentions.claim_text: He sees oil coming up out of the ground in Iraq, pipelines, major deals, buildings being built, cars and wealth coming out of Iraq with Saudi Arabia.
mentions.quote: All this oil coming out of the ground in Iraq
mentions.falsify_match: An Iraqi oil and construction boom on a Gulf state scale.
mentions.falsify_miss: Iraqi output and investment stay flat.

mentions.claim_text: He describes the rider with gauze coming off him carrying old scales in his hand, riding across the land in Europe, with drought and famine following.
mentions.quote: I saw scales in his hand
mentions.falsify_match: Famine and rationing conditions across Europe.
mentions.falsify_miss: No European food crisis.

mentions.claim_text: He says the figure was twenty four million with secret accounts of money fraud coming out of Ukraine, and that the black horse went on through Africa with great drought, beyond drought, while Iraqi and Saudi oil was plentiful.
mentions.quote: there was secret accounts of money fraud that was coming out of Ukraine
mentions.falsify_match: An accounting scandal of that scale is uncovered in Ukraine aid, and severe African drought follows.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such scandal or drought.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord was breathing on the Abrahamic covenant so the world would see it, with fruit the size of softballs, plentiful vegetables and fish coming up out of the sea in Israel.
mentions.quote: I saw fruit the size of softballs and tomatoes
mentions.falsify_match: Unusual agricultural yields reported in Israel.
mentions.falsify_miss: Ordinary yields. The fruit was baseballs in earlier tellings and softballs here.

mentions.claim_text: He describes the fish as blue on top fading to a white scaly underside, and bread with oats on top, and says the blessing trickled down on the nations that blessed Israel.
mentions.quote: those that blessed them were blessed
mentions.falsify_match: Nations supporting Israel prosper relative to those that do not.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such correlation.

mentions.claim_text: He says Netanyahu's days are numbered and a new leader is coming up out of Israel with a heart like David, wearing a small circular head covering.
mentions.quote: I saw BB's days were numbered
mentions.falsify_match: Netanyahu leaves office and an observant younger successor takes over.
mentions.falsify_miss: Netanyahu remains, or an older secular figure succeeds him.

mentions.claim_text: He adds that the new Israeli leader was not bald and not old looking or grey haired like Netanyahu, and asks the audience what the head covering is called, saying he is ignorant of it rather than insulting.
mentions.quote: he wasn't old looking like BB with a gray hair
mentions.falsify_match: A young observant Israeli leader takes office.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such succession.

mentions.claim_text: He sees the Mount of Olives split and the Temple Mount completely decimated where the Dome of the Rock is, though not uninhabitable, with the Lord saying to look at the trees to know the time.
mentions.quote: I saw the temple mount completely decimated
mentions.falsify_match: The Dome of the Rock and Temple Mount are destroyed.
mentions.falsify_miss: They remain standing.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls being told to look at the fig tree, describes the figs as vast and big, wonders whether the Mount of Olives actually has olives on it, and says he has never been to Israel and does not want to add to or take from it.
mentions.quote: I don't want to add to or take from
mentions.falsify_match: The timing sign resolves to something checkable.
mentions.falsify_miss: The sign stays uninterpretable, which he acknowledges here.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw great cyber attacks on America and on banks, naming Bank of America, banks in trouble and embarrassing moments, and cyber breaches at Charles Schwab.
mentions.quote: I saw banks that were in trouble. Embarrassing moments
mentions.falsify_match: A cyber breach at Bank of America or Charles Schwab.
mentions.falsify_miss: No breach at either.

mentions.claim_text: He says the banks would go to a certain cryptocurrency for cyber security, asking for knowledge on how to stop hackers breaking into their databases.
mentions.quote: they would go to a certain crypto for cyber security
mentions.falsify_match: A major bank adopts a named blockchain for security infrastructure.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such adoption.

mentions.claim_text: On a report that Iraq granted a Starlink licence alongside sixty billion in US deals, he says he told them Starlink would rise up in the Middle East, and describes a machine pulling pure water out of the atmosphere with internet provided.
mentions.quote: I said Starlink will rise up in the Middle East
mentions.falsify_match: Starlink becomes a major Middle Eastern provider and atmospheric water generators are deployed with it.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither happens. Starlink licensing across the region was already under way.

mentions.claim_text: He points back to words given over a year earlier about Iraq, saying he described a man with a five o'clock shadow and a moustache who has now come up.
mentions.quote: the man has a five o'clock shadow with a mustache
mentions.falsify_match: The named Iraqi figure matches the physical description given in advance.
mentions.falsify_miss: No match. A five o'clock shadow and moustache describes a large share of Iraqi male politicians.

mentions.claim_text: He cites Iraq signing forty eight deals with US companies during a Washington visit as the fulfilment of a word that Iraq would come up out of seemingly nothing and be like Saudi Arabia in the days ahead.
mentions.quote: they will come up out of seemingly nothing
mentions.falsify_match: Iraqi output and wealth approach Gulf state levels.
mentions.falsify_miss: Iraq stays economically constrained.

mentions.claim_text: He says parasites always come to ride a move, and that you have not made it until CNN, Fox or the New York Times persecute you.
mentions.quote: you have not made it until CNN persecutes you
mentions.falsify_match: Legacy outlets take an adversarial interest in him.
mentions.falsify_miss: They ignore him. Either outcome is read as confirmation here.

mentions.claim_text: He calls for revival in New York and says he sees the wells of revival opening again at Oral Roberts University and capped wells coming open.
mentions.quote: I see the wells of revival opening again at ORU
mentions.falsify_match: A recognised revival breaks out at ORU.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such outbreak.

mentions.claim_text: He calls a stirring throughout Asia, naming South Korea, Taiwan, Japan, China, India, Pakistan, Iran, Iraq and Afghanistan.
mentions.quote: I call stirring in the church in South Korea
mentions.falsify_match: Church growth across the named Asian countries.
mentions.falsify_miss: No measurable change.

mentions.claim_text: He calls the Clarity Act and the Save America Act to come forth with no more holding back, and says it is time for the rocket fuel.
mentions.quote: Clarity, come forth. Save America. Come forth
mentions.falsify_match: Both acts pass.
mentions.falsify_miss: Either fails.

mentions.claim_text: He says he does not believe the Save America Act will pass as a whole, that pillars of it will, that they will split it off and pass parts, and that he could be wrong.
mentions.quote: I don't believe the Save America Act will pass
mentions.falsify_match: Parts of the act pass while the full bill does not.
mentions.falsify_miss: The full act passes intact, or nothing of it passes.

mentions.claim_text: He says they saw red, white and blue again for the French flag and for an attack in the French Quarter again, recalling a black woman walking down Bourbon Street with red, white and blue glitter on her.
mentions.quote: The red, white, and blue for an attack in the French Quarter again
mentions.falsify_match: A second attack in the New Orleans French Quarter.
mentions.falsify_miss: No further attack there.
